about: Dom 2026-10-26: the physics package's M4 hit/cut rules evaluator (@frankendom/physics createEvaluator / evaluateHit, docs/API.md 'Rules evaluator', docs/M4-CALIBRATION.md) drives the opponent's ragdoll. PRESENTATION ONLY like data/physics.json: the 60 Hz sim (duel.ts) and Gate 0 never see it and nothing it does goes back into the sim. src/fight/rules-eval.ts reads every number and name here. OFF by default: V1's rules (today's behaviour exactly: every landed blow is the same stagger) stay the default until Dom approves, so he can A/B. `?<query>=<m4>` (?rules=m4) turns the evaluator on; `?rules=v1` (or no query) is the default. The rest of the page is unchanged under either. WHAT IT DOES ON: each sim Hit whose target is the opponent (the ragdoll exists only for him; a missile or a guarded blow is not a hit on his body) becomes one evaluateHit: `weapons` the attacker's V3 weapon -> the package's nearest weapon row (`rule`; `blunt` = a crushing weapon, evaluated as kind blunt) -- the package has only gm_gladius, gm_katana, gm_claymore, gm_dagger, gm_rapier, gm_battleaxe (and two with no length), so a longsword is the katana (0.97 m), a cleaver the battleaxe (1.04 m, longer than a cleaver), a trident and an estoc the rapier (1.15 m, slash 0.34, so they stab), a knife the dagger, and the hammers, maul, scythe, reaper and staff the battleaxe (blunt for the hammers, maul and staff); the kind is stab for a thrust (move-rows isStabMove), blunt for a `blunt` weapon, else slash. `swing` heavy for the moves in `heavyMoves` or the overhead heavy and its directional heavies (isHeavyMove), a CHARGED blow too; else light. `counterHit` is the sim's own counter / stop-hit flag on the Hit event. `zone` is the Hit's location (head, torso, legs; `legs` on `legSide`). `armour` per opponent (the Minotaur wears none today: tier `none`). `t` is the Hit's tick / `tickHz` (sim seconds). SPEED: the sim has no hand speed, so every blow is the package's TYPICAL LIGHT swing (rules.swing.hand_speed_ref_m_s.<handSpeedRef> = light_p50, 6.25 m/s; light_p90 = 9.74 is the full-speed swing its calibration table uses, and with it a longsword (the katana row, lever 2.72) cuts or kills on any torso or head blow, so a bare Minotaur would fall to every hit; flip this one row to see it) multiplied by the weapon's lever inside the evaluator; a heavy takes the SAME light reference with swing heavy (heavy_mult 1.92 stands for the charge: feeding the heavy animation's faster speed too would count it twice, Physics Dev's flag). WHAT IT DRIVES: outcome hit / stick -> the ragdoll's stagger with the blow's impulse scaled by strength (`impulseAt`: the package's strength rung at which the impulse is physics.json hit.impulse; clamped to `impulseClamp`); knockdown -> rd.knockdown(cause) for the evaluator's fall + down seconds, the bones following the ragdoll, then a get-up blend of `getUpS`; cut -> the blow staggers as a hit and the unit is queued (rules.cuts): it comes off the CORPSE when the sim kills him (ragdoll.ts cutUnit, physics.json cut; a living body cannot be carved yet), and under ?rules=m4 these evaluator cuts are the ONLY cut trigger (physics.json cut.onKill's head-zone rule, the corpse tap and the finisher's cut are off); kill -> the SIM decides death, never the evaluator: while the sim's opponent still lives the evaluator's kill is shown as a knockdown (`killAs`), counted in rules.deferredKills, and its fighter state is renewed (`renewOnKill`: the package's budgets are head 20 / torso 60, a bare Minotaur's head dies on one blow; V3's pools are the sim's); the sim's own Killed event is the only death, as before. A miss (below the speed gate or the hit rung) is no stagger. The evaluator state is one per page and renewed at the rematch. The last results, the totals and the cost are on globalThis.__v3Rules and window.__v3Fight.rules.
